title: 2024 Bowman #66 Gavin Williams Cleveland Guardians Baseball Card

descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Gavin Williams RC #66 Cleveland Guardians sports trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. Featuring a rookie card of the rising star, this card is perfect for collectors and enthusiasts alike. The card is from the Major League (MLB) and has been manufactured by Bowman, ensuring its quality and authenticity. 

The card is not autographed but still holds a lot of value. It belongs to the 2024 season and is part of the 2024 Bowman set. The card name is Gavin Williams Rookie 2024 Bowman, and it features the player's rookie status. The team is Cleveland Guardians, and the card number is 66. This trading card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress.
